Kwame Adjei-Rowe: Moss's Coastal digest from Sunday 2025-11-02 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." So the date to enter in the CRM is **November 3, 2025**.

Two caveats before you enter it:
- The digest was written the day before the handoff. It doesn't name you as the new owner, and it doesn't confirm the change actually happened that day.
- Moss's digests use "PHL" for both Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Covey & Lark Retail. Check the org ID so the date lands on the right account.
